# Support

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mlvpatel/RunLume/discussions) for setup questions and usage ideas. Use a bug report only for a reproducible defect.

Do not attach real transcripts, prompts, reasoning, tool results, credentials, account IDs, or local paths. Report security problems through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/mlvpatel/RunLume/security/advisories/new).
